items_note: These are the special items crafted by Vulcanusmon. Bring the listed materials to him. Items are permanent once crafted and enable Armor / Hybrid evolutions. X Antibody items are obtained differently (not forged here).

materials: Barbeque Skewers x4 +  Wolkenapalm I x1
Digimeat x5 +  Ignition Flare I x1
Fruit Tart x3 + Saint Knuckle I x1
DigiApple x5 +  Crush Blade I x1

how_to_use: Talk to Vulcanusmon in the Factorial Area (bottom level after story progress). Select the Forge option and provide the exact materials. Once crafted, equip the item in your inventory to unlock the evolution path for eligible Digimon (check requirements like level, stats, personality, and Agent Rank).
tips: Many base materials (e.g., Wolkenapalm I, move discs) can be bought from item shops or obtained from battles/exploration. Some higher-tier materials require farming specific areas or enemies.
